entries.title: Numbers 34:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 34:2
segments: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land which is to be your heritage, the land of Canaan inside these limits,)

entries.title: Numbers 34:3
segments: Then your south quarter will be from the waste land of Zin by the side of Edom, and your limit on the south will be from the east end of the Salt Sea,

entries.title: Numbers 34:4
segments: And round to the south of the slope of Akrabbim, and on to Zin: and its direction will be south of Kadesh-barnea, and it will go as far as Hazar-addar and on to Azmon:

entries.title: Numbers 34:5
segments: And from Azmon it will go round to the stream of Egypt as far as the sea.

entries.title: Numbers 34:6
segments: And for your limit on the west you will have the Great Sea and its edge: this will be your limit on the west.

entries.title: Numbers 34:7
segments: And your limit on the north will be the line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor:

entries.title: Numbers 34:8
segments: And from Mount Hor the line will go in the direction of Hamath; the farthest point of it will be at Zedad:

entries.title: Numbers 34:9
segments: And the limit will go on to Ziphron, with its farthest point at Hazar-enan: this will be your limit on the north.

entries.title: Numbers 34:10
segments: And on the east, your limit will be marked out from Hazar-enan to Shepham,

entries.title: Numbers 34:11
segments: Going down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain, and on as far as the east side of the sea of Chinnereth:

entries.title: Numbers 34:12
segments: And so down to Jordan, stretching to the Salt Sea: all the land inside these limits will be yours.

entries.title: Numbers 34:13
segments: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel saying, This is the land which is to be your heritage, by the decision of the Lord, which by the Lord's order is to be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe:

entries.title: Numbers 34:14
segments: For the tribe of the children of Reuben, by their fathers' families, and the tribe of the children of Gad, by their fathers' families, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, have been given their heritage:

entries.title: Numbers 34:15
segments: The two tribes and the half-tribe have been given their heritage on the other side of Jordan at Jericho, on the east looking to the dawn.

entries.title: Numbers 34:16
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 34:17
segments: These are the names of the men who are to make the distribution of the land among you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun.

entries.title: Numbers 34:18
segments: And you are to take one chief from every tribe to make the distribution of the land.

entries.title: Numbers 34:19
segments: And these are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

entries.title: Numbers 34:20
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel, the son of Ammihud.

entries.title: Numbers 34:21
segments: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad, the son of Chislon.

entries.title: Numbers 34:22
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Dan, a chief, Bukki, the son of Jogli.

entries.title: Numbers 34:23
segments: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh, a chief, Hanniel, the son of Ephod:

entries.title: Numbers 34:24
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chief, Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan.

entries.title: Numbers 34:25
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chief, Elizaphan, the son of Parnach.

entries.title: Numbers 34:26
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar, a chief, Paltiel, the son of Azzan.

entries.title: Numbers 34:27
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Asher, a chief, Ahihud, the son of Shelomi.

entries.title: Numbers 34:28
segments: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a chief, Pedahel, the son of Ammihud.

entries.title: Numbers 34:29
segments: These are they to whom the Lord gave orders to make the distribution of the heritage among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
